lines.text: Marked. Walk out of the Core slowly and I'll pretend I didn't see the colour of your name.
Reyes sent you. Tell Reyes the Row stays his exactly as long as it stays quiet.
Receipt noted. Your route, your losses, your decision. File all three.
Eight spawns cleared in your record. Brann calls it a first deployment below the old limit. Ask how the next patrol reaches it.
You copied a page of my book. My record for my successor. The Undercity appears twice. File what the next entry leaves out.
You have the gate-cycle record. Keep the times attached. An order and the reason for it are separate records.
Your work card records the stairwell. The residents still have to use it. File the proof where they can find it.
Marshal. You're in the Core; that's the good news. Don't make me give you the other kind.
Wake. Your lease and your grade are on the record. The Core has protection; past the ring road, check the street.
Marshal. You're in the Core; that's the good news. Don't make me give you the other kind.

barks.text: Curfew drills at oh-four-hundred. Same time every year. Same reason nobody asks about.
